question: Should the experimental OpenClaw Bay route again expose the restored queue-history and sampled exact-review telemetry after the rollback in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/586?
rationale: The patch is presented as a feature restoration, but the rollback deliberately removed the broader Bay/telemetry stack; only a maintainer can decide whether this renewed observability surface is now desired.

options.title: Sponsor bounded Bay observability
options.body: Accept the read-only Bay surface once the contributor supplies redacted final-head runtime proof from a deployed queue-backed route.

options.title: Defer the experimental surface
options.body: Keep the established overview and status APIs as the supported operational view and close or narrow this restoration until Bay is explicitly prioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded Bay observability
recommendation.body: Accept the read-only Bay surface once the contributor supplies redacted final-head runtime proof from a deployed queue-backed route.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincentkoc introduced the merged pressure-telemetry work and authored the rollback context most directly related to whether this surface should return.
